summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Ascentage Pharma Group International, a Cayman Islands-incorporated biotech listed in Hong Kong (Stock Code: 6855). The filing reports the further grant of 440,743 restricted share units and options to 453 employees under pre-existing equity incentive schemes (2021 and 2022 RSU schemes, Post-IPO Share Option Scheme). No merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special situation is involved. The grants are within previously approved shareholder mandate limits and represent approximately 0.12% of outstanding shares. This is ordinary equity compensation disclosure, not a special-situation event.
